systems.owner: Ministère de la Justice et des Droits de l'Homme (Unité de gestion du projet e-Justice; partners ONECI and ASERNUM)
systems.tiers: all 39 first-instance tribunals connected by 29 June 2026; online issue of nationality certificates and criminal-record extracts (bulletins 1, 2 and 3) nationwide

note: A justice-ministry portal through which the public obtains criminal-record extracts and nationality certificates from the tribunals; nothing on police or gendarmerie stations or their records.
